result.instructions: Tools for Referral Factory, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which referrers joined our spring campaign this month?"; "Show me the leads that are not qualified yet and mark the ones with a paid order as qualified."; "How many rewards are due right now, and for which campaigns?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Referral Factory data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run referralfactory_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run referralfactory_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run referralfactory_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. referralfactory_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: referralfactory_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List all referral campaigns in the account (name, code, status, dates, rewards). Start here to find a campaign id. Referral Factory API: GET /campaigns.

tools.name: referralfactory_get_campaign
tools.title: Get a campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign by its id or code, including its settings and rewards. Referral Factory API: GET /campaigns/{identifier}.

tools.name: referralfactory_list_referrers
tools.title: List referrers
tools.description: List referrers (the people who share referral links) in chunks of 25 by default. Each item has id, campaign_id, name, email, code and sign-up date. For more results, pass links.next from the last result as next_page_url. Referral Factory API: GET /referrers.

next_page_url.description: The links.next URL from the previous list result, to get the next chunk. Omit for the first chunk.

tools.name: referralfactory_get_referrer
tools.title: Get a referrer
tools.description: Get one referrer with all their data: referral link, sharing links, referrals and rewards. Referral Factory API: GET /referrers/{id}.

tools.name: referralfactory_search_referrers
tools.title: Search referrers
tools.description: Search referrers with filters, for example all referrers from one campaign or with a given source. Filter values are strings. Referral Factory API: POST /referrers/search.

field.description: Field name, e.g. first_name, email, campaign_id, source.

filters.description: Filter block: a list of field/operator/value conditions.

tools.name: referralfactory_create_referrer
tools.title: Create a referrer
tools.description: Create a referrer in a campaign. It appears with source API and gets a referral link. Set notify to true only when the person should get the invitation email. Referral Factory API: POST /referrers.

email.description: Email address of the referrer (unique within the campaign).

notify.description: true = send the invitation email. Default false.

tools.name: referralfactory_update_referrer
tools.title: Update a referrer
tools.description: Update a referrer's first name or email. Only the fields you pass are changed. Referral Factory API: PUT /referrers/{id}.

tools.name: referralfactory_list_leads
tools.title: List leads
tools.description: List leads (people referred by a referrer, not yet qualified or qualified) in chunks of 25 by default. For more results, pass links.next from the last result as next_page_url. Referral Factory API: GET /leads.

next_page_url.description: The links.next URL from the previous list result, to get the next chunk. Omit for the first chunk.

tools.name: referralfactory_get_lead
tools.title: Get a lead
tools.description: Get one lead with its referrer, qualification state and goals. Referral Factory API: GET /leads/{id}.

tools.name: referralfactory_update_lead_qualification
tools.title: Qualify or unqualify a lead
tools.description: Mark a lead as qualified or not qualified. Identify the lead by id, or by code, or by email plus campaign_id. Qualification can trigger the rewards set for it. Referral Factory API: PUT /leads/qualification.

code.description: Lead referral code or coupon code.

tools.name: referralfactory_list_goals
tools.title: List goals
tools.description: List goals across all campaigns (25 per page by default, up to 250). Each campaign also has a built-in Qualification goal. Referral Factory API: GET /goals.

tools.name: referralfactory_get_goal
tools.title: Get a goal
tools.description: Get one goal by id. A campaign's built-in Qualification goal uses the negative campaign id. Referral Factory API: GET /goals/{identifier}.

tools.name: referralfactory_list_due_rewards
tools.title: List due rewards
tools.description: List rewards that are due but not yet issued, for all campaigns, or for one campaign when campaign_id is set. Read only: this tool does not issue or cancel rewards. Referral Factory API: GET /rewards/due/all or GET /rewards/due/{campaign_id}.

tools.name: referralfactory_list_issued_rewards
tools.title: List issued rewards
tools.description: List rewards already issued, for all campaigns, or for one campaign when campaign_id is set. Referral Factory API: GET /rewards/issued/all or GET /rewards/issued/{campaign_id}.

prompts.title: Get started with Referral Factory
prompts.description: What you can do with Referral Factory here, with example requests to try.
